scope: Exploratory mean-response calibration development on the chosen Gaia FIELD star only; no quasar pixel use or held-out validation claim. Known ERR unmodified.
dilation_scope: Remaps the already pixel-integrated response empirically; not an exact optical wavelength/SED derivation.
jitter_scope: Positive Gaussian convolution of ePSF is a physically valid additional image-motion/diffusion mean response; kernel covariance changes the mean, not measurement errors.
